They help redistribute and alleviate increasing traffic loads on existing roads. Implementing intelligent toll collection systems is a successful solution for traffic management, positively impacting emissions reduction and environmental protection. It also contributes to the development of roadside infrastructure and services, fostering regional economic growth through job creation. Telematika has developed a Universal Digital Tolling Platform that integrates the three existing types of toll collection systems for highways. Market for highway tolling systems, 2023 14% Other 86% Telematika Next-generation toll gate system Free-flow tolling system Tolling systems based on satellite technologies Next-generation toll gate system Our fully domestically developed toll gate system hardware and software suite utilizes a classic “open and closed” system approach. This system can take payments at tolling points using any form of payment, such as cash, credit cards, and DSRC-transponders in express lanes, and includes the installation of boom gates at toll booths. Telematika’s toll gate system is used on the following highways: M-4 Don , M-3 Ukraine , M-1 Belarus , Western High-Speed Diameter in Saint Petersburg, Tver Bypass of the M-11 Neva , Tolyatti Bypass in Samara Oblast, Pur Most bridge crossing over the Pur River, the bridge crossing from Blagoveshchensk (Amur Oblast) to Heihe (Heilongjiang Province, China), and others. 570+ lanes throughout Russia use the Telematika's solutions 2000+ km of toll roads operate using the Telematika's solutions 1 / 1 Previous Next The next-generation toll gate system enables the operator to choose the optimal lane configuration The automated classifier developed by Telematika determines the type of the vehicle and the number of axles Thanks to short-range radio technology, DSRC ensures the quick, continuous passage with no need to stop Video clip: Toll gate system Free-flow tolling system Free Flow is a toll gate-free system that ensures seamless travel on toll roads without stops, thanks to its advanced AI-powered vehicle identification technology. Uninterrupted traffic without slowing down enables obtaining up to 50% savings in relation to the time en route, reduces freight traffic expenses and the risk of accidents, and improves the environmental condition owing to the reduction of traffic jams and the steady movement of traffic. Free Flow is supported by the following equipment installed on the gantries: An overview camera records that the vehicle has passed through A dedicated camera recognizes front and rear license plates A laser scanner determines the dimension of the passing vehicle An axle-counting camera determines the vehicle's class and axle count for accurate toll calculation DSRC antenna reads information from the transponder 99%+ The Telematika's market share in this tolling technology 200+ km/h Stable system operation at any speed 99% Likelihood of identifying the vehicle 1 / 1 Previous Next Free Flow ensures a high level of mobility and seamless interaction between the driver and the road Unlimited output capacity in comparison with roads with a closed system 1,115 km of toll roads in Russia operating with Free Flow technology developed by Telematika Since Free Flow was first implemented in Russia, over 370 million transactions have been processed on the Central Ring Road and M-12 highway Video clip: Free Flow Tolling system using global navigation satellite system This technology utilizes high-precision data from onboard devices installed in vehicles to enable continuous, distance-based tolling. Telematika developed the world's largest national satellite-based tolling system, designed to offset damage caused to federal highways by vehicles exceeding 12 tons. 66+ thousand km coverage of federal roads 1.9+ million trucks 1 / 1 Previous Next More than 600 thousand transportation and logistics companies use the Telematika’s satellite-based tolling system Telematika has created and delivered more than 3 million onboard devices to the tolling system operator The unique digital road model and powerful computing system ensure high accuracy Video clip: Satellite-based tolling system Projects on the basis of tolling systems 1 / 1 Previous Next Russia, Moscow region The Free Flow Toll Collection System of the Central Ring Road Russia’s first project based on the Free Flow technology Average traffic speed increase by several times Up to 50% reduction in travelling time Costs per vehicle 65% lower compared to other types of tolling Toll Road Length: 260 km 40,000 throughput (vehicles per day) Up to 99% vehicle Recognition at speeds 200+ km/h 2,500 transactions per minute Russia, Moscow Free Flow on the Moscow High-Speed Diameter Together with the Government of Moscow, a consortium of Telematika group companies implemented Free Flow for collecting tolls from transit traffic As part of the project, equipment was installed, software was created, the recognition of all transponders regardless of the operator was ensured, and digital control and cooperation was set up for the payment of parking and using the Moscow High-Speed Diameter (“Parking Russia”) 4 tolling gantries 350K vehicles daily 68 km length of the road Russia, Moscow – Nizhniy Novgorod – Kazan End-to-end project for the M-12 Vostok highway The automated traffic control system (ATCS), with its incident detection capabilities, and the Free Flow tolling system make the M-12 highway comfortable and exceptionally safe The ATCS and Free Flow use artificial intelligence and neural networks. The ATCS analyzes video surveillance data to automatically detect and respond to various events according to predefined algorithms. The Free Flow tolling system ensures seamless travel without stops through its advanced vehicle identification technology. Thanks to the Free Flow system, an area equal to 240 football fields was saved on the M-12 800+ km length of the toll road 25+ million trips since 2022 1,200 cameras of Free Flow and the ATCS Russia, Moscow – Voronezh – Rostov-on-Don – Krasnodar – Novorossiysk Barrier Toll Collection System of the М-4 Don Highway Implementation of a toll road management system Throughput of sections from 10,000 to 120,000 vehicles per day 17 toll plazas with dispatcher control systems 254 lanes Payment and tariffication management Multiple payment methods Covering: 1,517 км of total length 694 км of toll roads 12M+ vehicles monthly India, Deli-Mumbai Barrier-free electronic freight transport Toll Collection System in India Development, implementation, and maintenance of the GNSS-based tolling system of India’s key freight corridor (Deli-Mumbai) Toll collection, and fixed and mobile control system Transition from barrier systems to modern tolling technologies — non-stop cashless toll payment International tolling system based on GLONASS and NAVIC The efficiency and uniqueness of this solution were highly appreciated by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways of India 1,419 km toll road length 11M+ km of haulage 500 cargo vehicles Russia, Saint Petersburg Toll gate system on the Western High-Speed Diameter The Western High-Speed Diameter is the first intercity high-speed toll road in Russia The Telematika’s toll gate system hardware and software suite utilize a classic “open and closed” system approach. This system can take payments at tolling points using any form of payment, such as cash, credit cards, and DSRC-transponders in express lanes, and includes the installation of boom gates at toll booths 46.6 km total length of the road 100M transactions per year 16 tolling points 17 Flow+ tolling gantries Russia, Tver Oblast End-to-end project for the M-11 Neva highway (Tver Bypass) The northern Tver Bypass is the final stage of the M-11 Neva federal highway. It reduces travel time between Moscow and St. Petersburg by 30-50 minutes Throughout its entirety, the bypass features a cutting-edge, AI-powered smart infrastructure developed by Telematika, enabling incident detection, weather monitoring, traffic monitoring, and convenient toll payments. Telematika also equipped the road with a state-of-the-art toll gate system 62.4 km length of the road 4 traffic lanes Russia, Samara Oblast End-to-end project for the Tolyatti Bypass A new toll section of the Europe — Western China international transportation corridor is equipped with a suite of Telematika’s advanced AI-powered solutions The “smart” road infrastructure reduces the number of accidents, increases driver comfort, and increases the efficacy of managing traffic on the road. Cutting-edge IT systems enable continuous monitoring of road conditions, automatic incident detection, and notifying drivers of road conditions and occurrences.
